description: Check a social media creator's audience for authenticity signals before working with them: follower quality, engagement patterns, comment authenticity, growth and posting cadence. Returns an authenticity score (0-100) with the signals behind it and a link to the full public report. Works for Instagram best; YouTube, TikTok and X are read from public data where available. Accounts too small to judge get no score, by design. This is a signal check, not a ruling: "Flagged for review" means look closer, and it is not grounds to call a creator fake. Checks are limited per day; a recent check of the same account is reused for free.

handle.description: The creator's handle, with or without @, or a link to their profile.

platform.description: Where the account is: instagram, youtube, tiktok or twitter (x is accepted for twitter). Ignored when a profile link is given: the platform is read off the link.

name: check_creator

assessable.description: Whether a score was issued. False below the scale floor or when the profile could not be read.

authenticityScore.description: 0-100, only beside a scored verdict. Null means not issued, not zero.

link.description: The saved public report page. Null when it could not be saved.

nextStep.description: Unscored only: what the person can do about it.

reason.description: Unscored only: why no score was issued.

reused.description: True when a check of the same account from the last 30 minutes was reused.

scope.description: What was read, and what was not.

signals.description: The signals behind the score, at most 10. Empty when no score was issued.

kind.description: red a concern, yellow a note, green a good sign.

substitution.description: Present when a different account than the one asked for was checked, and says which.

verdict.description: The verdict in words. Never "fake": the worst reads "Flagged for review".

retryAfterSec.description: Seconds until the limit lets another call through. Absent when the limit is a plan's searches for the day.

error.description: What went wrong, in the words of the text answer.

title: Check a creator's audience
